essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.
No substitute past strands; nondual self yet cheating glamour; wish-tree sprouts powers, lordship, ending.
Already won, yet when won: tell; clear-heart tenant, ash-white swan bowed.
Twin lamps of waking and love begged; triple play staged and only poet fit to strike.
Real and fake made nought or aught by free-and-bound spender-sovereign.

sections.SUMMARY: Capped hunger bows to the crescent master; empty hands take shelter in all-helping force. Peerless past qualities, the self fools its own through fathomless sheen; still devotion fruits into supernormal bloom, endless sway, birth's close. Won already, the prize stays future — say when; the pellucid-breasted swan keeps house. Two flames are sued, knowing and loving; the worldwright who raised the boards alone can ring them down. Being and non-being trade places at the nod of the boundless bound one.

rasa.justification: Won yet unwon, staged yet unstaged: having bows to becoming; lamps lit against the wait.
